Looking for a risk-free, government-backed way to build a stable monthly income after retirement?

We break down how combining two popular Post Office schemes the Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS @ 8.2% p.a.) and the Monthly Income Scheme (MIS @ 7.4% p.a.) can help senior citizen couples generate over ₹52,000 every single month.

By allocating ₹60 Lakhs in SCSS (₹30L each) and ₹18 Lakhs in Post Office MIS (₹9L each), a retired couple can deploy ₹78 Lakhs to secure a regular, guaranteed payout of ₹52,100/month, achieving an average annual return of ~8.1% with 100% sovereign safety.

#assetyogi #mis #scss".
